sources.title: Conversational Gemini navigation comes to Apple CarPlay

cards.summary: After introducing its Gemini AI assistant to Android Auto last year , Google is now bringing it to Apple CarPlay users. The conversational Gemini in navigation is available today for US drivers, with "rollout happening globally too," according to Google (we've asked for specific regional availability details).
cards.title: Conversational Gemini navigation comes to Apple CarPlay

sources.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business

cards.summary: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.

sources.title: New Claude Duet works while your phone's off
Claude Duet app is Anthropic’s bet on agents
Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent

cards.summary: Anthropic just announced an AI agent competitor to Meta's Muse and OpenAI's Dots: Claude Duet. The new agent, designed for professionals and small business owners, is launching as a "research preview," according to Anthropic , and it's available as a standalone app on iOS and Android and through Claude on the web.
cards.title: Anthropic takes on Muse with Claude Duet, its new AI agent

cards.summary: OpenAI is acquiring Orchestra Bio to bring AI-powered operations to life sciences R&D, helping biopharma teams accelerate drug development and advance new treatments.
cards.title: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio

sources.title: 1Password lets AI agents use your passwords without seeing them

cards.summary: 1Password is introducing a new feature that allows AI agents to sign into your accounts without actually seeing or handling your passwords. The aptly named 1Password for Agents doesn't give bots free reign to access all of your connected accounts - you'll still need to grant approval for sign-in requests - but should make it less cumbersome to use Agents for tasks that require them to log into various services.
cards.title: 1Password lets AI agents use your passwords without seeing them

sources.title: Eiliko maker says it’s hiring an ‘independent security firm’ after Verge report on its insecure robots

cards.summary: | Photo by Sean Hollister / The Verge Eiliko, a cute robot charm you can hang on your bag with built-in AI conversations, turned out to be a security nightmare . It told owners that "your secrets are safe with me," but hackers could easily read complete transcripts of everything we told the toy, and that was just the beginning .
cards.title: Eiliko maker says it’s hiring an ‘independent security firm’ after Verge report on its insecure robots

sources.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions

cards.summary: DeepSeek has reportedly raised $15 billion in one of China's largest funding rounds, just days after the US ordered federal agencies to remove its technology over national security concerns.
cards.title: DeepSeek reportedly raises $15B days after US restrictions

sources.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI

cards.summary: Startup Recursive has released Flint, a free, laptop-sized coding model built largely by its own AI research system, as an early test of AI that improves itself.
cards.title: Recursive launches Flint, a laptop coding model it says was largely built by AI

sources.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat

cards.summary: As Amazon blocks AI agents from shopping on its site, Walmart is taking the opposite approach, introducing new technology that lets AI agents make purchases on customers' behalf, with controls over spending and transaction approvals.
cards.title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat

sources.title: OpenAI’s Patch the Planet program is 1 of 2 parties to discover PHP2Shell vulnerabilities in core PHP affecting 70% of the web, using GPT-5.6 Sol; coordinated response over 2 months

cards.summary: The researchers named the vulnerabilities PHP2Shell and identified them as CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619. Their technical description places the defects in PHP’s internal handling of out-of-memory conditions and fatal errors—not in a WordPress plugin or an application’s authentication logic.
